nom: The Ordinary Balancing & Clarifying Serum for Oily Skin and Pore Refinement

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often report reduced shine and oil control over the day, though two describe the opposite, saying the serum made their skin greasier or left a shiny film with no improvement.
segments.dry: One reviewer with normal-to-dry/reactive skin found it a gentle maintenance product that kept blemishes at bay without irritation, while another with generally oily-to-dry skin noted skin appeared drier after cleansing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally describe balanced, hydrated, breakout-free skin with smoother texture and reduced oil in T-zones by end of day.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no stinging, burning, redness or irritation, and several highlight it as gentle enough for reactive or sensitive-nosed users despite the scent.
segments.mature: The one reviewer identifying mature skin (combined with oily-to-normal) found it a good value product, and another in her 30s/40s reports reduced fine lines and smoother expression-line areas.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal-to-dry/reactive skin describes it as a mild, effective maintenance serum with no irritation.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers report smoother texture and softer skin around fine lines or expression lines, and one mentions wrinkles looking smoother after a month of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates without dryness or tightness, but two report skin feeling drier after use, and one felt it was too mattifying for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report reduced contrast between redness and normal skin tone and calming of irritation, with no cases of increased redness mentioned.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers say it strengthens or supports the skin barrier and layers well under moisturizer/sunscreen without pilling; no barrier-related complaints appear.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with problem or hormonal spots describe faster clearing of individual blemishes and spot areas, including overnight or within a couple of days, though one reviewer saw new blemishes form on forehead and cheeks.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne- or blemish-prone reviewers report fewer, less inflamed, or fully cleared breakouts including cystic and hormonal acne after weeks of use; a minority (2-3 reviewers) report no improvement or worsened breakouts and one describes skin peeling.
concerns.oiliness: Many oily-skin reviewers describe a visible reduction in shine and more balanced oil through the day, but at least two reviewers report the product made their skin oilier or left a persistent shiny film.

aspects.libelle: No pilling under moisturizer or makeup
No noticeable results after weeks of use

extraits.texte: Used this for about a month daily as instructed. I noticed that it left a shiny film on my face during the day which some may like the "dewy glow" look it casts. I don't since I have naturally oily skin to begin with. After a month of use, I did not see an improvement to my skin and actually noticed more blemishes form on my forehead and cheeks. I also noticed that my skin appeared dryer after cleansing. Did nothing for texture or pores. I would skip this product.

I have very sensitive and acne-prone skin, and have been struggling with acne as a teen. when i first spot tested the product, it seemed great! when i applied it to the rest of my face, i noticed no stinging, burning, imflammation, or redness! i went to bed, and when i woke up, i noticed an immediate difference. i had less texture, my acne was less imflammed and less visible, and my pores were noticeably smaller and cleaner! i highly recommend this product for anyone with skin like mine!

This is one of my HG products. I'm halfway through my second bottle now. I apply this morning and night first thing after cleansing. It feels gently moisturizing. My skin seems to get extremely oily with hormonal fluctuations, and this genuinely helps reduce the oiliness without drying me out at all. It works incredibly well under makeup and sunscreen — no pilling whatsoever!! It also doesnt cause my skin to peel, get flaky, or feel dry and tight, which were common issues I've had with other products that claim to reduce oiliness. In my 30s, I have had new ongoing issues with acne along my jaw and chin. This is the only product that's helped reduce that issue completely when I use it consistently morning and night. Only a few drops are needed for my face (don't need a whole droppers' worth). About that smell….I have an incredibly sensitive nose. It's unfortunately true that this product smells bad. It is not rancid, it just smells that way. I apply this product to my face, let it dry down for a minute or two, and then put my moisturizer on top. The odor dissipates a few minutes later after it dries/my skin absorbs the product, usually in less than 15 minutes. This serum works so well for me that I don't mind dealing with the odor. It's truly not that bad for my sensitive nose, but your mileage may vary with your own smell sensitivity. I love this product and will continue to use it.

I've had cystic acne on my neck for nearly a year that cleansers, spot treatments, and pimple patches couldn't clear. After adding this to my routine 2x daily, it's nearly all gone! My skin also feels noticeably less oily and my foundation holds out much longer. I will never use another serum!

I occasionally get a pimple here and there — I'm in my 30s + have normal-to-dry/reactive skin. This is a great maintenance serum to keep blemishes at bay. I would not say it is a super strong product, which makes it perfect for individuals with sensitive skin. It absorbs quickly, and layers well on top of other serums/toners + under more occlusive products like moisturizer and sunscreen. All in all an excellent value given the price point.

I've been using this for the past month on my rosacea covered skin, and i have noticed far less texture, specifically under my chin, which used to be super bumpy. I also have seen a marked improvement in the evenness of my skin tone, now, dont get me wrong, it didn't get rid of my rosacea, but the harsh contrast line between my redness and regular tone has blended together much more seamlessly. will be repurchasing.

extraits.titre: A Clear Solution for Troubled Skin
extraits.texte: I recently started using a balancing and clarifying serum aimed at improving skin texture and clarity, and I must say, it's become a crucial part of my skincare routine. This serum targets excess oil and blemishes, which has been a persistent issue for me. The lightweight formula is one of its best features. It absorbs into the skin quickly without leaving a greasy residue, making it perfect for use under makeup or as a stand-alone treatment. I've noticed a significant reduction in shine throughout the day, and my complexion appears more balanced and less prone to breakouts. The serum also includes ingredients that help to soothe and calm the skin, which has been great for reducing redness and irritation associated with acne. The subtle, fresh scent is refreshing and not overpowering, which I appreciate in skincare products. However, those with extremely dry skin might find it a bit too mattifying. It's ideal for combination to oily skin types, particularly those dealing with acne or general skin congestion. Overall, this balancing and clarifying serum has been effective in controlling oil, reducing blemishes, and leaving my skin looking healthier and more even-toned. It's a fantastic choice for anyone looking to tackle these specific skin concerns with a gentle yet effective product.
